subject: general
question:
Refer to the given number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) & 3 Ω # 2 & % 4 6 @ 8 $ 7 1 * £ 5 (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series, which of the following will be seventh from the right?
solution:
Given series:

(Left) & 3 Ω # 2 & % 4 6 @ 8 $ 7 1 * £ 5 (Right)

If all the symbols are dropped from the series, the remaining series will be:

(Left) 3 2 4 6 8 7 1 5 (Right)

Counting from the right, the seventh element is:

(Left) 3 2 4 6 8 7 1 5 (Right)

Seventh from the right: 2

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)"**.
